title: Allah Allah Karrahe hai husain
body:
Allah Allah Karrahe hai husain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ajeeb shor hai
Ajeeb shor hai ... Ke shor me sukoon hai 2
Ajab sukoon hai...
Ajab sukoon hai
Sukoon me junoon hai 2
Ye wo junoon hai
Ye wo junoon hai ...
Jo deen ka sutoon hai 2
Ya kya ye kyu ye kaise hai ye sochna haraam hai
sochna haraam hai
Kisi basher ki baat ka khuda ka khud kalaam hai
khuda ka khud kalaam hai
"Fazkoruni azkoro kum washkoruni Wala taghforun"
Quran mein khud kahta hai khuda
Wo mujhko kabhi jhutlata nahi Aur mere shakir rahta hai
Jo mera zakir hota hai mai uska zakir banta hu
<<MINI>>
Allah allah kar rahe hai husain
Ya husain ya husain ya husain Ya husain
Allah allah kar rahe hai husain
Kar raha hai Khuda hussain ya husain
Ya husain ya husain ya husain Ya husain
<<DIVIDER>>
1)Khauf ahle sitam pe hai taari
Zikre shabbir ab bhi hai jaari
Jab khuda khud hai zaakire hai sarwar
Kaun rokega ye azadari
Ishk ka Tarjuma husain husain
<<MINI>>
Kar raha hai khuda hussain husain
Ya husain ya husain ya husain Ya husain
Allah allah kar rahe hai husain
Kar raha hai khuda hussain husain ...
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Kah diya aayae mawaddat ne
Hamse manga hai kya risalat ne
Ab bhi Aqlo pe hai pade parda
Raaze quran na samjha ummat ne
Rabte zahra hai ya husain husain
<<MINI>>
Kar raha hai khuda hussain husain
Ya husain ya husain ya husain Ya husain
Allah allah kar rahe hai husain
Kar raha hai khuda hussain husain ...
<<DIVIDER>>
3) uski baatil namaz hojae
Shak jo zaate husain me lae
Jo namaze khuda ko thukrae Phir wo matam liye kaha jae
Hy Shaoore baka husain husain
<<MINI>>
Kar raha hai khuda hussain husain
Ya husain ya husain ya husain Ya husain ...
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Kaise kaidi the karbala wale
Sheh ke maksad ko sath leke chale
Kab wo gaafil rahe hai sajdo se
Kaid mein bhi namaz padhte rahe Aur jaari raha husain husain
<<MINI>>
Kar raha hai khuda hussain husain
Ya husain ya husain ya husain Ya husain ...
<<DIVIDER>>
5)Jab madine me aae ahle haram
Rozo shab tha husain ka matam
Ab bhi taarikh de rahi hai sada
Ghar me sajjad ke khuda ki kasam
Eid ke din hua husain husain
<<MINI>>
Ya husain ya husain ya husain Ya husain ...
<<DIVIDER>>
Sada ye gaib se aati hai ibne zahra ki
Ye kaisi bahes me uljhi hui hai kaum meri
namaz ka koi munkir hai majliso ka koi
takallum aur hai darvesh ki tamanna yahi
<<DIVIDER>>
khudara jism ko tum jaan se juda na karo
namaz aur aza ka tum mukabla na karo
Ay mere bhai raza, mai saniye zainab hoo
Tu saniye hussain, ay ghareebul ghurba
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay mere bhai raza, tujhpe humsheer fida
AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA, AY MERE BHAI RAZA, TUJHPE HUMSHEER FIDA , AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA
Tujhse milne ke liye kitne meelo ka safar
Teri zainab ne kiya
<<MINI>>
AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA.
<<DIVIDER>>
1)Mujhko pardes my ye baat rulati hi rahi
door hoo ghar se magar sar pe rida hai bhai
binte zehra ne magar shaam o koofa ka safar
be rida kaise kiya
<<MINI>>
AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA.
<<DIVIDER>>
2)Tera deedar bina bhai nahi reh sakti
gham mai furqat ka teri aur nahi seh sakti
kya mujhe bhool gaye tumko behna se milay
ek baras beet gaya
<<MINI>>
AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA.
<<DIVIDER>>
3)Tumko zindan may kahi qaid na karle koi
mere baba ki tarha zeher na dede koi
jee nahi paungi mai sun ke mar jaungi mai
tumko gar kuch bhi hua
<<MINI>>
AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA.
<<DIVIDER>>
4)Baap ki tarha mere sar pe tera saaya hai
apni beti ki tarha tune mujhe paala hai
tu hai ay bhai jahan mujhko bulwale wahan
hoga ehsaan tera
<<MINI>>
AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA.
<<DIVIDER>>
5)Saath hum hotay agar shaam ko jaate bhai phir sakina ke liye ashk bahate bhai
kya nahi tum ko khabar aagaya maahe safar
waarise karbobala
<<MINI>>
AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA.
<<DIVIDER>>
6)Maut se pehle mujhe milne baradar aaja
apni sughra ke liye ay mere akbar aaja
dil may hasrat hai mere dekhloo chehra tera phir mujhe aaye khaza
<<MINI>>
AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA.
<<DIVIDER>>
7)Ay takallum ye behen bhai pe jaan deti thi
sunke bhai ki khabar khaak pe ye aise giri
lab pe tha haye raza dil pe kaabu na raha
kha gayi usko Qazaa
<<MINI>>
AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA.
